notes: The app on the home screen is no longer a floating window. It used to be launched as a freeform window sized to the stage, which is why it drew its own title bar, would not stay where it was put, sank behind the launcher and never lined up. Freeform is Android's floating-window mode and all three faults belong to the system, not to DWM, so the window is gone. The stage now draws a card for your chosen app - its glyph, its name, a fullscreen button at the top and a big OPEN FULLSCREEN button - and opening it launches the app normally, full screen. Press Home to come back. Tapping an app in the drawer opens it and remembers it as the home app. Open in window, Raise windows and the Window title-bar fix setting are all gone with the mechanism they served.
